basic_details.job_title: Sainik School Mainpuri Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for TGT, Counsellor Posts

age_limit.details: All Posts: Minimum Age: 21 Years, Maximum Age: 50 Years.

qualification.education_qualification: Four years integrated degree / Bachelor's / Master's degree with B.Ed / CTET / Graduation in Psychology/Child Development
qualification.details: TGT English: Four years integrated degree course from NCTE-recognized university with at least 50% marks in concerned subject and aggregate with B.Ed component OR Bachelor's/Honours Degree with at least 50% marks and B.Ed/three years integrated B.Ed-M.Ed OR Graduation in concerned subject with 50% marks and 1-year B.Ed (Special Education) from RCI OR Post Graduate in concerned subject with 50% marks and three year integrated B.Ed-M.Ed. Qualified in Central Teaching Eligibility Test (Paper-II). Competence to teach through English and Hindi languages. Counsellor: Graduate/Postgraduate in Psychology OR Postgraduate in Child Development OR Graduate/Postgraduate with diploma in Career Guidance and counselling. Candidates having below 50% marks in any exam up to Graduation are not eligible.

selection_process: Written Test Class Demonstration/Skill test Interview
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for Sainik School Mainpuri Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.sainikschoolmainpuri.com.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 25-10-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Sainik School Mainpuri for filling up TGT English and Counsellor positions on a contractual basis in the state of Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for recruitment under this notification, distributed among TGT English and Counsellor posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of completed offline application forms along with required documents and fees is 25-10-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for Sainik School Mainpuri Recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the form, fill it, and send it via post to the school address.

faq.question: Q5. What are the age limits for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for candidates applying to these posts is a minimum of 21 years and a maximum of 50 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for TGT English?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a four-year integrated degree, Bachelor's/Honours degree, or Post Graduation with B.Ed and qualified CTET Paper-II.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Counsellor post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Counsellor post will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs 25,000/- to Rs 45,000/-.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: General and OBC category candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 500/- through a non-refundable Demand Draft.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these contractual posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Written Test, followed by a Class Demonstration or Skill test, and finally a personal Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the filled offline application form be sent?
faq.answer: The application form must be sent to the Principal, Sainik School Mainpuri, Village - Nouner Kharra, Agra Road, Mainpuri, Uttar Pradesh - 205119.
